files.README.md:
# Larkspur Community Library - first-quarter loan export

Circulation counts include only loans marked circ=Y. Interlibrary loans (item_type ILL) are marked circ=N: another library owns the item, so they never count toward branch circulation.

Shelf cart
- Returns get wiped down at the sorting desk.
- Audiobook cases travel in the padded crate.
- The label sheets restock on Thursdays.
